hypothesis: Holding horizon changes the risk/return profile of frozen v30 isotonic-4 signals; test holding_days in {3,5,7,10,14} crossed with {1x, dd_guard} sizing. No refitting; calibrated scores untouched. Exploratory only.
family: R1-A holding horizon matrix on frozen calibrated predictions

reselection.description: Replicate swing_signals loop EXACTLY (same monthly cap + cooldown policy) but call choose() with modified cfg where ONLY holding_days=[h]. Frozen prediction columns sliced to the matching holding subset (base grid alternates 3d/7d per candidate index: even=3d, odd=7d). Entry offsets, brackets, and policy thresholds identical to base. Causal past-only.

execution_override.description: Frozen calibrated predictions cover ONLY 3d/7d candidates, so re-selection for novel horizons would require new inference (forbidden: never refit). Instead keep the frozen base-grid selection (control signals) and override holding_bars=h*288 at execution with a matching per-branch max_holding_bars cap. Selection is untouched; only the time-exit horizon varies. Causal past-only; truncated end-of-data windows are rejected by the engine and counted.

control: base holding grid [3,7] @1x; must match published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 normal (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: YOUR control-branch (control_1x) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times
